spans.s: śrotaka (IE 8-5; EI 32), a kind of rent; cf. śrotra, etc.
śrotra (IE 8-5; EI 32), probably, a tax in kind collected from farmers by a lessee of State lands; same as Marāṭhī śilotara, śilotarī or śilotrī; cf. śrotaka.
śrotriya (SITI), land or a village granted to a Śrotriya or Brāhmaṇa learned in the Vedas.
